verdict.rationale: Recurly documents an official public MCP server, Compass, that lets agents like Claude Desktop or Cursor 'work directly with Recurly's tools and APIs'. It also has a full API with official client libraries and report exports covering subscriptions, invoices and transactions. However, Compass is mainly described as connecting AI tools to 'documentation and API knowledge', so it is unclear whether an agent can query live account billing state through it. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the MCP server queries live account data, documented agent access to MRR/delinquency/renewal metrics, hands-on or independent corroboration.
